mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.5 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of cases over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month, SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of cases over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals an imminent recessionary supply shock, causing a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO < 100, SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of cases over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) signals weakening economic activity, reducing corporate profit expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 declines quarter-over-quarter, SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of cases over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 3.0% signals rising inflation expectations, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%, SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of cases over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rises in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal severe labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month, SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of cases over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: During high-rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, a decline in FEDFUNDS does not lead to positive SPX 20-day returns in > 60% of cases over the last 10 years.
